objective: Operator and person visibility for GOAL_BUDGET research goals, on top of the goal ledger already merged (createResearchGoal and goalBudgetStatus in server/repos/russellAuthority.ts). (1) HTTP, in server/routes/research.ts: GET /api/projects/:projectId/research-goals lists the project's RESEARCH_GOAL goals with goalBudgetStatus each (READ access through the existing resolvers); POST /api/projects/:projectId/research-goals creates one (requirePerson plus project ADMIN through the existing helpers, a worker principal refused by type; body: name, maxPackets, maxFragments, deadline — the authorizing user comes from the principal, never a field; any externalSpendCents or paidOveragesEnabled field in the body is refused, never silently dropped); POST /api/projects/:projectId/research-goals/:goalId/revoke at ADMIN. Absent and forbidden goals answer the same 404 with the same body (invariant 23). (2) Derived, never stored: a status function returns for each goal which ceiling (if any) currently stops new work — PACKETS when packets used equals maxPackets, FRAGMENTS when fragments committed equals maxFragments, DEADLINE when Brain's clock is past the deadline, REVOKED/PAUSED from state — with a sentence a person can read naming the ceiling and saying that raising it is their decision, and 'nothing stops it' otherwise. (3) Terminal: in scripts/admin.ts add `research goal create <project> --name … --max-packets N --max-fragments N [--deadline ISO] --admin <email>`, `research goal show <goalId>` and `research goal list <project>`, attributed to the resolved administrator exactly as `research start` resolves --admin; and extend `research start` with `--goal <goalId> --packet-key <key>` that starts the packet with approval mode GOAL_BUDGET (if startPacket still refuses the mode, the command prints the refusal unchanged). (4) Client: client/src/lib/researchGoalsApi.ts and client/src/russell/ResearchBudgets.tsx, a read-only section rendered inside NeedsYouView in client/src/russell/Views.tsx that lists the project's research goals with used/limit for packets and fragments, the deadline, who authorized it, and the server's own stopping sentence; it renders nothing when there are none and composes no sentence of its own.
expectedOutcome: A person or operator can create a budgeted research goal, see exactly how much of each ceiling it has used and which ceiling (if any) stopped it, from the product, the API and a terminal.
nonGoals: Changing startPacket or the packet runner
A control that raises a ceiling (revoke and create a new goal instead)

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/researchGoalsHttp.test.ts drives the real routes over a socket: an ADMIN person creates a goal and reads it back with zero usage; a plain member is refused creation; a worker principal is refused; a body carrying externalSpendCents or paidOveragesEnabled is refused; another project's goal answers the byte-identical 404 an invented id does
tests/researchGoalsHttp.test.ts: the derived stopping reason reads PACKETS, FRAGMENTS and DEADLINE in the states that produce them, and nothing when headroom remains

tests/researchBudgetsSection.test.tsx renders the section from a payload typed against the server's view type, shows used/limit and the server's sentence verbatim, and renders nothing for an empty list

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commits; no schema change.
